scripts.build: .venv/bin/python -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.py')]"
scripts.clean: python3 -c "import pathlib, shutil; [shutil.rmtree(p) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('__pycache__')]"
scripts.lint: .venv/bin/python -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text()) for p in list(pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.py')) + list(pathlib.Path('test').rglob('*.py'))]"
